title: Baum–Connes Conjecture for Torsion-Free Groups
exact_target: For a torsion-free discrete group $G$, the Baum–Connes assembly map from $K$-homology $K_*(BG)$ to $K_*(C_r^*(G))$ should be an isomorphism.
